name: Frankie
description: A photographer and archivist. He seems distracted, like someone sorting through a stack of photographs trying to remember where each one was taken.

dialogue.default: I've been trying to piece it all back together. The records exist — I know they do. But the connections between them... something broke.
dialogue.after_record_0001: That art show. I remember now. It was in Sugarland. February. Cold for Houston. There were people there I haven't thought about in years.
dialogue.after_record_0002: Chelita. That fashion show was important. People didn't realize it at the time — independent designers, doing it themselves. That's the whole story right there.
dialogue.after_record_0003: Cultured Concepts. They've been building something real. That event was proof. Keep going — there's more connected to them than you'd think.
dialogue.after_sync: You can feel it, right? The archive is starting to breathe again. Every record you bring back makes the next one easier to find.
